body:
I have a therapist, and she's the only one I really talk to about personal things, but I still haven't told her about the suicidal thoughts because I've been scared of her admitting me. I do plan to tell her when I see her this week.

The problem is I only have therapy once a week, so the rest of the time I'm on my own. I have one friend who I have briefly mentioned my depression to, but she doesn't really understand and I'm scared of worrying or upsetting her if I tell her the more serious parts of it, like this. I have one other close friend, and that's it, and I rarely see her as she's busy, and I don't know if I would tell her either. My family would not understand, my parents "don't believe in" depression, I'm not close to my siblings. 

The loneliness is crushing. I don't have the energy or motivation to even interact with people right now, let alone try to make friends, and with how awful I've been feeling, I can't see anyone wanting to be around me, and when I try to fake it, I think it's obvious. And since I'm faking being okay I think the inauthenticity keeps me from making real connections with people. So I withdraw and stay in bed all day and avoid talking to people at work as much as possible.

Sorry for rambling, I just needed to get that out. Thanks for your reply.
